character: Iconic purpose-built resort at 1,860m on a sunny south-facing plateau. Lively, colourful, 250km Grand Domaine. 21 runs on own doorstep. Ice rink, cinema, swimming pool, spa. Famous for 21-turn Le Pas de la Confusion off-piste route in the Sarenne valley. Sarenne glacier skiing.
activities_nearby: Ice rink, swimming pool, cinema, spa, paragliding, snowshoeing, 250km Grand Domaine, 21 black runs, Sarenne glacier. 16km Sarenne run (longest black in Alps).
